description: Draws a sine, triangle or square from a phase ramp, with a pulse-width bend and a phase offset, on as many polyphonic channels as it is fed.

params.text: Bends the phase before the wave is drawn from it, 0 to 1; at 0.5 the wave is left alone, and moving away squeezes one half of the cycle and stretches the other.
Steps the wave through sine, triangle and square; the display names the one in use once the knobs have been left alone for two seconds.
Switches the output between 0-10V and ±5V, which the display reads back as UNI or BI.
Rotates the wave inside the cycle, a full turn either way at the ends of its travel.

inputs.text: Adds to the pulse-width bend, a tenth of the range per volt, and the total is clamped between 0 and 1.
Subtracts from the phase offset, a fifth of a turn per volt.
The phase ramp the wave is drawn from, 0-10V per cycle; with nothing patched the output holds at whatever level the phase offset alone points to.

outputs.text: The wave, 0V to 10V, or ±5V when the display reads BI.

notes: The display is two switches stacked on one another. Clicking its upper part steps the waveform; clicking the strip along its bottom edge switches between unipolar and bipolar output.
The channel count comes from whichever of the three inputs carries the most, and the output is set to match.
Each channel takes its own pulse width and phase offset from the matching channel of the PWM and SHIFT inputs.

inputs.0:
0 to 10V · continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads the PWM knob alone; a negative voltage subtracts from the knob.
inputs.1:
±5V · continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads the SHIFT knob alone.
inputs.2:
0 to 10V · continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads a phase held at the SHIFT setting.
